recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-subject ensemble portrait featuring eight musicians arranged in two horizontal tiers against a vibrant teal, textured background. The composition is anchored by large, distressed slab-serif typography in the center, flanked by decorative stars, creating a symmetrical and high-energy promotional layout.
coreVisualRelationships: Tiered arrangement of subjects surrounding central typography
High-contrast teal background against warm skin tones and earth-toned clothing
Distressed, weathered texture applied to both background and main title text
Symmetrical balance created by the placement of four subjects on top and four on bottom
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typography with inner distressing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are medium-close-up portraits; four positioned along the top edge and four along the bottom edge, framing the central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, two-line title in the horizontal center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large central text, move outward to the individual portraits in a circular motion, and settle on the smaller metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the teal background serves as a connective tissue between tightly packed subjects and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (Browns, greens, and blacks in clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background contrasts with the natural, slightly desaturated tones of the photographic portraits.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Inner 'cut-out' or weathered effect within the glyph bodies

composition.relationshipToImage: layered on top of background but behind foreground subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured slab serif for impact paired with a clean, condensed sans-serif for legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of eight diverse country-style musicians (men and women in cowboy hats and denim) arranged in two rows (4 top, 4 bottom) against a textured teal background with a dark vignette. Leave a large horizontal gap in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, two-line centered text in a distressed cream slab-serif font. Place two small outlined stars on either side of the second line. Add smaller condensed sans-serif text above and below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background a textured teal?
Is the main text a heavy, distressed slab serif?
Are there stars flanking the central text?
Is the ensemble arranged in a tiered layout?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the ensemble
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the distress texture.
Verify the teal background has sufficient grit and variation.
Check that the subjects do not obscure the primary title.
Confirm the stars are symmetrically placed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble portrait + [Color] textured background + [Distressed Slab Serif] central title + [Star] accents = Country Music Aesthetic.
